cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental principle or force underlying the universe, often associated with the Daoist concept of the Dao. It is ineffable and cannot be fully described in words.
cards.Nuance (English): The Dao is not a physical thing but an abstract, cosmic principle that governs all things.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the eternal Way; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical path or route taken by people or vehicles.
cards.Nuance (English): This usage is more concrete and refers to a literal path rather than the abstract Dao.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): Travelers walked along the road.|Carts and horses passed along the road.|This path leads to the mountain top.|There are trees by the road, with thick foliage.
cards.Sentences: 行人沿道而行。|車馬沿道而過。|此道通向山頂。|道旁有樹，枝葉茂盛。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): To express something verbally or in writing.
cards.Nuance (English): This is a rare and archaic usage, often found in classical texts.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The way of the gentleman cannot be expressed in words.|He spoke what he saw to show others.|He spoke his words, and people believed him.|He spoke his thoughts to compose an article.
cards.Sentences: 君子之道，不可言也。|道其所見，以示於人。|道其言，人皆信之。|道其所思，以成文章。
